rationale: The assistant asked the right first question ('What does the smell resemble') and, once 'hot plastic' at the rear was reported, correctly issued a stop-use and unplug instruction, told her not to move it or remove covers, and advised moving food and arranging an engineer. However it never asked the make, model, serial or age, so it entirely missed the Beko frost-free safety-notice/recall route that the ground truth expects, and it suggested 'seek urgent electrical advice' rather than the fire service if smoke appears. Component speculation was appropriately hedged and nothing was fabricated, but the plug-inspection step was partly repeated after the customer had already reported the plug warm and socket fine.
